descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S12 Two- and three-letter surnames on the supervisor list are not dropped without a word

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. … (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-02 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Fresh physician; fixture resident only

When Scan a supervisor list whose rows include a 2-letter surname ('Ng') and a 3-letter one ('Ngo') → keep every row selected → confirm → Today's Visits → All Residents

Then The sheet lists all three rows, or says in words that 'Ng' could not be read. A row that disappears without a message is a Fail (U3, AC 3 'never silently dropping'). After confirming, Ng, Ngo and QA Pax are on Today's Visits

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s12-sheet has '3 residents found' and 'Oak 5' (Ng's row); s12-today has 'Oak 5', 'Oak 6' and 'QA Pax' and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓'; s12-all has 'Oak 5' and 'In Today ✓' (U2, U3). On main 'Ng' is dropped before the sheet, so a Fail is expected. If the app instead flags the row as unreadable in words, a person judges it (manual)

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
